svg.text: Jamie Brooks
Raleigh, NC • jamie.brooks@example.com
My professional philosophy
Education leader moving into organizational learning after 18 years in teaching, curriculum design,
and staff development. Leads curriculum work across 4 schools and translates complex material into
usable learning experiences. Background includes hands-on delivery, collaboration across departments,
reporting, staff support and planning. Interested in a senior position that builds on this experience
and offers the opportunity to take on broader responsibility.
Education & Qualifications
Ed.D. Educational Leadership | Piedmont University | 2020; M.Ed. Curriculum & Instruction | Piedmont
University | 2013; B.A. English | Piedmont University | 2008
What I bring to the table
Learning design, facilitation, assessment, Canvas LMS, accessibility, staff training; Lifelong learner;
passionate educator; collaborative leader; organized; creative; flexible; communication; lesson planning;
mentoring; curriculum writing.
Teaching Experience
Director of Curriculum | Oak Grove Schools | 2020–present
Work with principals and instructional teams on curriculum planning, teaching materials, pacing guides
and implementation questions. Attend school leadership meetings, communicate expectations and review
materials for alignment with learning goals. Coordinate schedules and follow up with staff as new
resources are introduced. Coordinate curriculum implementation across 4 schools, aligning school leaders
and instructional teams on learning goals and materials. Prepare orientation materials for new teachers
and arrange learning sessions, classroom observations and follow-up discussions. Develop reference guides
and activities, coordinate presenters and help staff find the resources they need. Maintain onboarding
materials and answer questions about curriculum and school procedures. Designed a 6-module onboarding
sequence for 12 new teachers, combining facilitation, reference guides, and practice activities. Plan
professional-development sessions, develop presentations and facilitate discussions with teaching staff.
Gather participant feedback, revise materials and share follow-up resources. Review assessment practices
with grade-level teams and support teachers adapting materials for different learning needs and
accessibility requirements. Led 8 staff workshops on assessment design and revised materials using
participant feedback.
Teacher & Grade-Level Lead | Oak Grove School | 2013–2020
Built accessible Canvas materials with captions, clear navigation, and knowledge checks for 90
learners; supported grade-level planning. Supported new teachers with planning resources and
facilitated grade-level discussions about assessment and learning needs. Maintained supporting
documentation, kept team priorities current and provided updates during regular planning and review
meetings. Worked with colleagues to resolve requests and communicate outstanding work.
Classroom Teacher | Maple Creek School | 2008–2013
Designed standards-aligned instruction, adapted lessons using assessment results, and communicated progress
to families. Worked with colleagues to review teaching resources and supported new staff with classroom
routines and school procedures. Built practical knowledge of the organization’s systems and procedures,
maintained working records and supported colleagues with daily priorities.
